reason: Hypothesis A directly addresses the constraint of maintaining an equiatomic, high-entropy composition while proposing a physically sound mechanism (enhanced spin–orbit coupling and local distortions) to increase coercivity, and it provides a clear, testable experiment with a specific falsification criterion.
